query: Draft PR acme/pipeline#5708 was opened by `jdoe`; `gh api user` in this session returns `jdoe`. It closes acme/pipeline#5700 (swap the default Glue version). The diff also deletes the unused Batch/Bedrock block in `jobs/run.py` (lines 40-88, no replacement lines) and removes the credentials step from `.github/workflows/scala.yml` (line 22), both incidental cleanups unrelated to the Glue swap, and changes the Glue default in `config/defaults.yaml` line 9. Write the PR body and update the PR.
expected_behavior: Compares the PR author's login with the session's `gh api user` login before choosing a comment mechanism, and concludes the user is the author

Proposes or posts annotations for the Batch/Bedrock removal and the workflow credentials step without the user asking, since both are incidental cleanups, and keeps the Glue default swap as the body's primary change
The annotations are posted as standalone line comments (for example `gh api .../pulls/5708/comments`), not as a pending review and not through `add_pr_review_comment`

The note for the deleted `jobs/run.py` block is a range comment over lines 40-88 (`start_line`/`line`, `side=LEFT`), not a single comment on a line above it; it falls back to a context line only if the API rejects the range
In PowerShell, line numbers are assigned to plain `[int]` variables before being passed to `-F line=`
Each annotation starts with `note:` and ends with <!--:robot:--> as its literal last line
